e.title: 上海保险交易所（SHIE）：登记/交易/风控合规服务与新能源车险平台
e.title_en: Shanghai Insurance Exchange (SHIE): registration, trading and risk-compliance services, plus a new-energy-vehicle insurance platform
e.title_hk: 上海保險交易所（SHIE）：登記／交易／風控合規服務與新能源車險平台
e.summary: 中国保险市场基础设施：登记流程、交易融资、信息管理、运营管理与风控合规服务，并设新能源车险交易平台与区块链服务平台
e.summary_en: China’s insurance market infrastructure: registration, trading and financing, information management, operations and risk-compliance services, with a new-energy-vehicle insurance trading platform and a blockchain service platform
e.summary_hk: 中國保險市場基礎設施：登記流程、交易融資、信息管理、運營管理與風控合規服務，並設新能源車險交易平台與區塊鏈服務平台
e.body:
**上海保险交易所（SHIE）** 是**中国保险市场的基础设施机构**（经国务院批准设立的保险资产登记与交易平台）。本条目属本轮「**中国形态缺口**」：实测池内 **SHIE 相关条目为 0**，而池内中国侧已有监管（[[nfra-portal]]、[[nfra-statistics]]、[[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]]）、行业组织（[[china-insurance-association]]、[[china-actuarial-association]]）与工具/课程（[[china-insurance-actuarial-cn]]、[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]] 等），**缺的正是「市场基础设施」这一层**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：首页 66KB，导航结构实测完整——**关于我们**（公司简介 / **信息披露** / 公司构架 / 大事记）、**综合服务**（**登记流程服务** / **业务流程服务** / **交易融资服务** / **信息管理服务** / **运营管理服务** / **风控合规服务**）、**新闻中心**（保交所动态 / 媒体看保交所 / 公告通知）、**政策法规**（法律法规 / 部门规章 / **业务规则**）、**会员专区**（会员登录 `huiyuan.shie.com.cn` / 会员须知）；其中 **信息披露页 40KB、业务规则页 45KB 均实测 200**。⭐ 首页实测另给出两块具体业务平台：**「新能源车险交易平台」**（自述为「为新能源车险专属产品服务的综合交易服务平台」）与 **「区块链服务平台」**（底层技术、服务内容与业务场景）。⚠️ **如实标注一处**：**区块链服务平台页 `/iec/iec.html` 实测仅 541 字节**（近乎壳页），**故词条只写「首页列出该平台」，不对其内容作实质描述**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「保险市场基础设施」这一形态**——池内条目多集中在**产品、模型、数据与监管**，而**「保单/保险资产在哪里登记、如何交易融资、风控合规如何被平台化」**此前没有入口；对做**保险资金运用、保险资产交易、资产负债管理**方向的学生，SHIE 的服务清单本身就是**中国保险资金链条的结构图**（登记 → 业务流程 → 交易融资 → 信息管理 → 运营管理 → 风控合规）。**② 新能源车险是一个真实的中国特色业务**——中国是全球最大新能源汽车市场，**新能源车险专属产品**在定价与赔付上有显著差异（电池、智能驾驶、维修网络），SHIE 的交易平台说明这一险种已形成**专门的产品与交易基础设施**；与池内车险与车联网条目（[[insurance-telematics]]、[[driver-behavior-telematics]]、[[insurance-frequency-severity]]、[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]）可并读。**③ 区块链与信息管理**反映中国保险基础设施的技术路线，可与 [[insurance-data-tools]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 等「数据与接口」条目对照。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页导航结构、信息披露页与业务规则页（均 200）**，**但未打开任何披露文件或业务规则正文**，因此**不能确认其规则内容与披露口径**；**②** **会员专区需要账号**（`huiyuan.shie.com.cn` 登录），**非会员无法核实会员侧功能**；**③** 区块链平台页 541 字节、**不构成可核实的服务描述**（已如实写明）；**④** 本站**不提供精算模型或直接可下载的统计数据集**（中国保险业统计数据见 [[nfra-statistics]] 与 [[china-insurance-association]]）。**核实说明**：首页（66KB）、信息披露页（40KB）、业务规则页（45KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取导航与正文；**未打开披露文件或规则正文，未登录会员区**。

e.body_en:
**The Shanghai Insurance Exchange (SHIE)** is an **infrastructure institution of China’s insurance market** (an insurance asset registration and trading platform established with State Council approval). This entry follows this round’s "**China form gap**" approach: a measured search found **zero SHIE-related entries**, while the China side of the corpus already holds supervision ([[nfra-portal]], [[nfra-statistics]], [[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]]), industry bodies ([[china-insurance-association]], [[china-actuarial-association]]) and tools/courses ([[china-insurance-actuarial-cn]], [[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]] and others) — what was missing is precisely **the market-infrastructure layer**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is 66KB and its navigation is fully measurable — **About us** (company profile / **information disclosure** / organisational structure / milestones), **integrated services** (**registration process services** / **business process services** / **trading and financing services** / **information management services** / **operations management services** / **risk and compliance services**), **news centre** (SHIE news / media coverage / announcements), **policies and regulations** (laws / departmental rules / **business rules**) and a **members’ area** (member login at `huiyuan.shie.com.cn` / member notes); the **information disclosure page (40KB)** and **business rules page (45KB)** were both measured at 200. ⭐ The homepage also names two concrete business platforms: a **"New Energy Vehicle Insurance Trading Platform"** (described as an integrated trading service platform for NEV-specific insurance products) and a **"Blockchain Service Platform"** (underlying technology, services and business scenarios). ⚠️ **One thing stated honestly**: the **blockchain platform page `/iec/iec.html` measured only 541 bytes** (essentially a shell), so **this entry records only that the homepage lists the platform and makes no substantive claim about its content**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "insurance market infrastructure" form** — corpus entries cluster around **products, models, data and regulation**, while **"where policies and insurance assets are registered, how they are traded and financed, and how risk and compliance are platformised" had no entry point**; for students working on **insurer asset allocation, insurance asset trading or ALM**, SHIE’s service list is itself **a structural map of China’s insurance capital chain** (registration → business process → trading and financing → information management → operations → risk and compliance). **② New-energy-vehicle insurance is a genuinely China-specific line** — China is the world’s largest NEV market, and **NEV-specific products** differ materially in pricing and claims (batteries, assisted driving, repair networks), so a dedicated trading platform shows the line has acquired **its own product and trading infrastructure**; readable with the motor and telematics entries [[insurance-telematics]], [[driver-behavior-telematics]], [[insurance-frequency-severity]] and [[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]. **③ Blockchain and information management** reflect the technology path of Chinese insurance infrastructure, comparable to data-and-interface entries such as [[insurance-data-tools]] and [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage navigation, the information disclosure page and the business rules page (all 200)** **but opened no disclosure document or rule text**, so **their contents and disclosure conventions cannot be confirmed**; **②** the **members’ area requires an account** (`huiyuan.shie.com.cn` login), so **member-side functionality could not be verified**; **③** the blockchain platform page at 541 bytes **does not constitute a verifiable service description** (recorded as such); **④** the site **offers no actuarial models or directly downloadable statistical datasets** (Chinese insurance statistics are in [[nfra-statistics]] and [[china-insurance-association]]). **Verification note**: the homepage (66KB), information disclosure page (40KB) and business rules page (45KB) were measured at HTTP 200 and their navigation and text read; **no disclosure document or rule text was opened and the members’ area was not entered**.

e.body_hk:
**上海保險交易所（SHIE）** 是**中國保險市場的基礎設施機構**。本條目屬本輪「**中國形態缺口**」：實測池內 **SHIE 相關條目為 0**，而池內中國側已有監管（[[nfra-portal]]、[[nfra-statistics]]、[[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]]）、行業組織（[[china-insurance-association]]、[[china-actuarial-association]]）與工具/課程，**缺的正是「市場基礎設施」這一層**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 66KB，導航結構完整——**關於我們**（公司簡介／**信息披露**／公司構架／大事記）、**綜合服務**（**登記流程服務**／**業務流程服務**／**交易融資服務**／**信息管理服務**／**運營管理服務**／**風控合規服務**）、**新聞中心**、**政策法規**（法律法規／部門規章／**業務規則**）、**會員專區**；其中**信息披露頁 40KB、業務規則頁 45KB 均實測 200**。⭐ 首頁另給出兩塊具體業務平台：**「新能源車險交易平台」** 與 **「區塊鏈服務平台」**。⚠️ **如實標注一處**：**區塊鏈服務平台頁實測僅 541 字節**（近乎殼頁），**故只寫「首頁列出該平台」，不對其內容作實質描述**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「保險市場基礎設施」這一形態**——池內條目多在**產品、模型、數據與監管**，而**「保單／保險資產在哪裏登記、如何交易融資、風控合規如何平台化」**此前沒有入口；SHIE 的服務清單本身就是**中國保險資金鏈條的結構圖**。**② 新能源車險是中國特色業務**——中國是全球最大新能源汽車市場，**專屬產品**在定價與賠付上差異顯著，交易平台說明該險種已有**專門的產品與交易基礎設施**，可與 [[insurance-telematics]]、[[driver-behavior-telematics]]、[[insurance-frequency-severity]]、[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]] 並讀。**③ 區塊鏈與信息管理**可與 [[insurance-data-tools]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 對照。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁導航、信息披露頁與業務規則頁（均 200）**，**但未打開任何披露文件或規則正文**；**② 會員專區需要賬號**，**非會員無法核實會員側功能**；**③** 區塊鏈平台頁 541 字節、**不構成可核實的服務描述**；**④** 本站**不提供精算模型或可直接下載的統計數據集**。**核實說明**：首頁、信息披露頁、業務規則頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開披露文件或規則正文，未登錄會員區**。
